title: VendorList $select omits dcfg_latitude/dcfg_longitude but distance-search reads them -- geo filter always empty
detail: Line 74: `$select=dcfg_vendorid,dcfg_display_name,dcfg_legal_name,dcfg_address,dcfg_city,dcfg_state,dcfg_email,dcfg_phone,dcfg_trade,dcfg_active_flag`. No dcfg_latitude, no dcfg_longitude. But line 115 reads `v.dcfg_latitude` and `v.dcfg_longitude` to compute haversine distances. Those fields are undefined on every row, so distance search always returns zero matches. The 'Distance Search' feature in the Vendor List is visually present but never works against database vendors.
recommendedFix: Add `dcfg_latitude,dcfg_longitude` to the $select on line 74. Confirm dcfg_vendor has these columns (not all vendors will -- the distance-search UI may need geocoding on first use).

title: VendorList geocodes via hardcoded `nominatim.openstreetmap.org` URL
detail: Line 83: `fetch('https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&q=' + ...)` -- hardcoded third-party geocoding service. OpenStreetMap's Nominatim has a usage policy limiting to 1 req/sec and requiring a User-Agent header. This fetch sets neither, so heavy use could get the SPA IP-banned from the free Nominatim instance. Should be configurable via dcfg_configs and should set a User-Agent.
recommendedFix: Move the geocoder URL to dcfg_configs (`dcfg_geocoder_url`). Add a User-Agent header identifying the DCFG portal. Consider caching geocoded addresses in localStorage to avoid re-geocoding the same search.

title: VendorList load failure silently shows 'Loading...' with no recovery -- no error state
detail: Lines 74-76: `.catch(function () { setLoading(false); });`. If the vendor query fails, `loading` is set to false and `vendors` stays as the initial empty array. The user sees an empty vendor table with no indication that a load error occurred. No error state, no retry button, no toast.
evidence: VendorList.jsx:74-76 -- catch sets loading=false but no error surface.
recommendedFix: Add an error state variable. In the catch, set the error message and show it above the table with a Retry button. Pattern: `var _err = useState(null); var error = _err[0]; var setError = _err[1];` and `setError('Failed to load vendors');` in catch.

title: VendorList $select requests dcfg_active_flag but renders 'Active'/'Inactive' column without filtering inactive vendors
detail: Line 74: query has no `$filter=dcfg_active_flag eq true`. Line 288: renders `v.dcfg_active_flag !== false ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'`. This means inactive vendors appear in the list. Every other list screen (Locations, Customers, MSAs) filters by dcfg_active_flag eq true. VendorList is inconsistent -- it shows soft-deleted vendors mixed with active ones. If this is intentional, it needs documentation. If not, it's a data leak.
evidence: VendorList.jsx:74 no active_flag filter, :288 status column rendering both states.
recommendedFix: Add `$filter=dcfg_active_flag eq true` to the query unless the design intent is to show inactive vendors. If showing both is intentional, add a toggle like Locations has for 'Include inactive'.
